items.item_text: Experience using Aggie Enterprise, Cashnet, Handshake and Aggie Expense.
Experience working with faculty in a higher education environment.
Experience interpreting UC policies and procedures for fiscal management, campus services, purchasing and accounts payable.
Experience with event planning in a higher education environment.
Experience with administrative and financial work requiring accuracy and attention to detail.
Experience to research, mine, create, elicit, analyze, and summarize information from a variety of sources to prepare reports and financial information in user-friendly formats.
Experience developing, implementing and maintaining a record-keeping system.

Under general supervision of the Fiscal Officer, provide administrative and financial support for a subset of faculty, programs and operating units in the School of Education. Process purchasing, accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions; research/resolve discrepancies and other accounting issues; assist with planning and executing a wide variety of events, seminars, workshops, and conferences; assist faculty, programs and units with processing student assistant hires, travel/entertainment policies and procedures, and other special projects; assist with fiscal closeout activities at year-end.
Knowledge of UC travel, entertainment and event policies and procedures.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to apply in a broad range of situations.
Ability to discern confidential information, keep appropriate information confidential, determine sensitivity of issues, and communicate tactfully and professionally.
